provenance.numeric_basis: Exact participant-level primary-source records only; the target review is used only for private reconciliation.

excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0023: The comparator diarrhea count is not reported and cannot be inferred as zero.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0024: The white cohort was open-label and had no randomized comparator.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0025: Three dropouts were attributed to several mixed causes; diarrhea-specific allocation is unavailable.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0026: Only rounded arm percentages are printed for diarrhea; exact participant counts cannot be asserted from them.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0027: Diarrhea is listed only as one component of a gastrointestinal category and has no separate count.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0028: The count combines nausea, diarrhea, and epigastric discomfort.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0029: The report summarizes event episodes rather than participants with diarrhea; event counts cannot be used as binary participant counts.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0030: Diarrhea and nausea are combined and cannot be separated.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0031: The outcome is a combined withdrawal endpoint, not participants with diarrhea.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0032: The category combines abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, and other symptoms.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0033: Only rounded percentages are present in the supplied report; exact participant counts cannot be recovered without the unavailable supplement.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0034: The source reports gastrointestinal discomfort, not diarrhea separately.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0035: The source reports a gastrointestinal composite; only two placebo withdrawals mention nausea and diarrhea together.
excluded_candidate_reasons.ce_0036: Diarrhea is named but no separate arm-level diarrhea count is reported.

pooled_results.outcome_group: Participants with at least one diarrhea adverse event
